decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model product line close to the core software business and publicly tied to the firm's digital direction, it carries high sunk costs and visible commitment, so management is very unlikely to withdraw it after only one year.

The education institute builds on existing training and customer relationships, and although it was not promoted as strongly as A, the growing firm is likely to persist with it because it supports the broader offering and does not yet clearly warrant abandonment.

The remote support tool fits the established support business, but because public commitment appears limited and it is less central to the announced strategic direction than A, it has the highest withdrawal risk of the three even though management would still more likely retain it.
